title: if your new sword only changes a number, keep it.
author: Equivalent-Honey5812
selftext:
Every sword in Aldermoor: The Sundered Crown has its own named right-click move. Boss weapons get their own sounds, combos and abilities, too.



I made it on Spawn by talking with Savi, with friends building alongside me. A crewmate asked for those sword abilities. I kept sending the boss weapons back for another pass and asked for a Mythic tier above legendary. We made the design calls. Savi helped.



What makes you keep a weapon after you find one with better stats?
